title: Projektetage Resize Handles Alignment
description: Fix interactive resize on projektetage: content scales uniformly inside the frame (no text reflow overshoot); resize handles aligned with selection chrome.
summary:
Fixed resize handles staying inside the selection and vanishing during resize drag.

- Removed `display: contents` + unpinned/pinned mode switch on canvas slides; positioned dispositions always use a wrapper frame (`--canvas-framed`) so chrome stays `inset: 0` on the same box as the highlight.
- Removed uniform CSS `scale()` on content/chrome during resize (it pulled handles inward); the wrapper now resizes directly.
- Resize handles use pointer capture on the handle element; chrome/handles get higher z-index.
- 44 renderer tests pass.
